free_tier_limits: Free public endpoints with best-effort service. CC BY-SA permits any purpose, including commercial use, provided TVmaze is credited and ShareAlike is followed. Allows at least 20 calls per 10 seconds per IP.
rate_limits: At least 20 calls every 10 seconds per IP address. Edge-cached requests may not count; temporary stricter limits may apply. Clients should back off and retry after HTTP 429.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL incorrect; commercial use is allowed under CC BY-SA with attribution and ShareAlike, and the free plan is best-effort: https://www.tvmaze.com/api#licensing and https://www.tvmaze.com/api/plans. rate_limits: ORIGINAL incorrect; docs say at least 20 calls/10 seconds/IP, with cache and temporary-limit caveats: https://www.tvmaze.com/api#rate-limiting. cors: ORIGINAL incorrect; all endpoints are CORS-enabled: https://www.tvmaze.com/api#cors.
